messages:
Elaine: quick sync 1: pilots sent wishlist: per-route batching/caching suggestions, quant presets by instance class, and eval-triggered alerts. need a scoping proposal.
Ming: for an alpha id recommend recommendations-only (no auto-apply), a small scoring job, and a Console card + CLI hook to pull suggestions. keep rollout manual.
Raj: eval alerts: start simple 1 threshold alerts over a golden prompt set + plugin points for custom metrics (per-route f1, exact-match). tier the alerts (warn/critical).
Olivia: quant presets: two starting profiles: "latency-lean" (aggressive int8) and "cost-lean" (safer 8-bit) with a runtime safety check to fallback to fp16 if perf/regression detected. need infra tests for KV cache correctness under quant.
Sam: ops constraints: sampling only, store prompt hashes not raw text, scrub PII, opt-out flag per-org, KMS for any suggestion apply, and audit logs for all changes. also need rollback playbook.
Jordan: CS asks: pilots will require weekly syncs, a short rollback SLA (24h), and acceptance criteria: <2 regressions on top-20 golden prompts after change. they want onboarding checklist.
Ming: rough timeline: suggestion engine + small scorer + UI = 3 sprints (eng+ml), eval-alert infra = +2 sprints, quant preset validation = +2 sprints (parallel testing might shrink it).
Elaine: proposed alpha scope (MUST/MAY): MUST: route-level batching/caching suggestions + Console card + CLI apply workflow (manual). MAY: simple eval-triggered alerts (threshold-based) + quant presets if infra tests clear. Launch criteria: end-to-end suggestion loop, alerts firing on pilot evals, pilot onboarding doc + signed pilot agreements.
Raj: launch metrics to track: adoption rate within 7d, alert false-positive rate <5%, no >10% GPU/CPU spike post-apply. we should sample baseline metrics before apply.
Olivia: UX sketch: tiny Console card showing suggestion, estimated delta (latency %, cost %), confidence score. example payload to display:
```
{
  route: "/complete",
  suggested_batch: 24,
  cache_ttl_seconds: 900,
  quant_preset: "latency-lean",
  est_latency_delta_pct: -18,
  est_cost_delta_pct: -22
}
```
Jordan: pilot prospects: KudoHealth, Nota, LumenAI. i'll confirm contact and ask for golden prompts + acceptance checks.
Sam: ops rollout checklist (draft): set sampling rate, enable PII scrub, org opt-out default = false, create audit log stream, pre-apply canary (small traffic), manual rollback and post-rollback verification script, runbook for noisy alerts.
Elaine: action items: Ming -> short RFC (scope + timeline) by EOD Fri; Raj -> eval harness + metric hooks; Jordan -> confirm pilots & NDAs; Sam -> ops checklist + runbook; Olivia -> quant test matrix. i'll schedule 30m follow-up monday. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: RFC template created at /docs/rfcs/optimize-toolkit-alpha.md
thread_text: Alpha scoping for Optimize Toolkit: prioritize route-level suggestions (batching/caching), eval-triggered alerts, and optional quant presets; define launch criteria, pilot requirements, and ops safeguards
